explication: Sentry is the official Elixir SDK for reporting errors, logs, traces, metrics, and check-ins to Sentry. The principal workflow is an application invoking the SDK (or an attached handler/integration capturing activity), the client preparing and filtering telemetry, and the transport sending it. The README documents the major capture capabilities; sampled source confirms client dispatch and application startup wiring. Other subsystem links reflect module responsibilities and documented integrations, but their internal call chains were not sampled.
